description: This file defines a grain class `LoadGrain` implementing the `ILoadGrain` interface, responsible for generating load by invoking `IPingGrain` instances and collecting reports on their success or failure. It contains methods to generate load, retrieve the report asynchronously, and resolve pending operations.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A class representing a load generator grain that manages workload execution and reporting for ping grains.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the load generation by scheduling the `RunGeneration` task.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current report after signaling completion of workload.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Executes the load generation loop, periodically invoking ping grains and updating the report until signaled to end.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Handles the resolution of pending ping grain calls, updating the report based on success or failure.
